info.title: AceData_Producer_Music_Studio
info.description: Generate music and lyrics, extend or transform supported tracks, and retrieve tasks or export formats with Producer. Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the response format returned by the server.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples.

seed.description: Random seed used for audio generation.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

model.description: The model used for generating music is `FUZZ-2.0` by default.

action.description: Types of audio generation operations. Supported values include `generate` (generate based on prompts), `cover` (cover song), `extend` (continue writing), `variation` (variant), `swap_vocals` (replace vocals), `swap_instrumentals` (replace instrumentals), `replace_section` (replace section), `stems` (separate tracks).

custom.description: Is it a custom mode? If `true`, the audio will be generated based on the `lyric`; otherwise, it will be generated based on the `prompt`.

prompt.description: Prompts for generating audio should not exceed 200 characters in length.

audio_id.description: The unique ID of the reference song.

weirdness.description: The degree of uniqueness of style can be selected between 0 and 1, with a default value of 0.5.

continue_at.description: Specify the time point (in seconds) from which to continue writing the song.

callback_url.description: The callback URL that will be called after the audio generation is completed.

instrumental.description: If `true`, the generated audio will only contain the accompaniment, without vocal lyrics.

sound_strength.description: The impact intensity of the audio prompt words can be selected between 0.2 and 1, with a default value of 0.5.

lyrics_strength.description: The degree of influence of lyrics on audio generation can be selected between 0 and 1, with a default value of 0.5.

replace_section_end.description: Replace the end time point of the segment (seconds).

replace_section_start.description: Replace the starting time point of the segment (seconds).

post.description: Producer AI music generation API, generates 1 song per request. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/producer-audios Submit once with async=true. Retain task_id and poll the matching task tool; a task ID is not a completed result. Do not resubmit while pending.
